name: mirage
text: Nothing new is waiting to release: v1.0.129 (the typing fix) is already out, and I haven't written the startup fix yet. I checked the bets store and it already loads off the main thread, so I was wrong to blame it alone, and I don't yet know what stalls the first screen (8.8 s). I'm adding per-stage startup timings to the next version so the report names the stage instead of me guessing. I'll tell you when it's out.
